scope: UC166 schema, create service/RPC/repository, dialog and related tests

findings.title: Validate the transferee independently on blur
findings.detail: Empty numeric fields become NaN and abort full schema parsing before superRefine can add the blank new-holder issue. Disabled submit leaves the incomplete draft without blur feedback. Current tests prefilled numeric fields.

reviewer_limits: Static review plus an in-memory schema check. No DB/native Auth/HTTP, network, writes or Git mutations. Parent-reported115/11 not rerun by reviewer.

resolution.repair: Shared independent shareTransferTransfereeSchema reused by full schema and dialog field feedback, so unfinished numeric draft cannot hide the transferee explanation.
